raw_response:
I will mostly do what has worked for me here in Quzhou: keep the main land in wheat-maize, and only leave a small piece for zucchini because vegetables need more hands and my family also has off-farm work. I have 31.5 mu total, so I will put 28.5 mu into the wheat-maize rotation and keep 3 mu close to the well for zucchini. I do not like cutting fertilizer too hard. If I save a few yuan on fertilizer and lose yield, that hurts more than spending a bit extra. So I will keep wheat and maize on the steady side, close to what good growers around me do, and I will feed zucchini heavier because it pulls hard and I can see the difference quickly. For wheat, I will aim for stable ears and grain fill with 3 irrigations if water is normal. For maize after wheat, I will use no-tillage where I can to save time and labor, then give 2 irrigations from the well if rain is not enough. For zucchini, I will plant hybrid seed, water more often, spray more often, and push fertilizer harder because that crop only pays if it keeps setting fruit steadily.
